description: This file defines the configuration class 'AttendancePluginConfiguration' for the Attendance plugin within the OrangeHRM project. It implements the 'PluginConfigurationInterface' and registers the 'AttendanceService' in the dependency injection container during initialization.

classes.name: AttendancePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the Attendance plugin, responsible for registering attendance services during plugin initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the AttendanceService into the dependency container.
